operation.description: Materialize the complete extension-by-zero table of the principal Dirichlet character modulo a bounded positive modulus. The returned canonical value composes directly with exact character evaluation.

examples.description: Compute the complete principal character modulo 12; the modulus must be positive and its full residue table must fit the 2,048-entry bound.
examples.name: principal_character_mod_12

input_schema.description: Materialize the complete principal-character table for one modulus.

modulus.description: Positive modulus; the complete residue table has exactly this many entries and is bounded to 2,048 entries.
modulus.title: Modulus

input_schema.title: PrincipalDirichletCharacterRequest

output_schema.description:
The extension-by-zero principal character modulo one fixed modulus.

``values[a]`` is the exact value of the principal character at the
canonical residue ``a``.  The unit residues and complete table bind this
value to its modulus without relying on a backend-specific group basis.
output_schema.title: PrincipalDirichletCharacter

operation.title: Compute an exact principal Dirichlet character

server.name: jacobian
server.title: Jacobian Mathematical Workbench
